title: The National Governors Association proposes a split of AI regulation roles, asking the US government to review AI models while letting states protect consumers
html:
This is a Techmeme archive page. It shows how the site appeared at 4:15 AM ET, November 23, 2026.

The most current version of the site as always is available at our home page. To view an earlier snapshot click here and then modify the date indicated.
summary: The National Governors Association wants the federal government to review AI models while leaving other rules to states.
